Looping in some technical detail here — high-level runbook and gating:

1) Canary scope: payments write path (card-authorize + tokenization). Read-only flows excluded from initial canary.
2) Metrics to monitor (pass/fail): error-rate <= 0.5% absolute increase vs baseline; p50/p95 latency under agreed thresholds; no increase in user-facing failures; KV cache hit-rate consistent.
3) Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate above threshold for 20 minutes OR critical data divergence observed by Novaflow telemetry.
4) Cutover play: staged cutover per region (west->east), automated feature flags ready to switch back.

Action items for Redwood: provide draft runbook (canary checklist + rollback steps) by Jan 11. Anita: confirm any extra logging hooks needed for your telemetry team.
